newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: S&P raises SBC Warburg Australia debt to AA plus.
newsitem.headline: S&P raises SBC Warburg Australia debt to AA plus.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said on Tuesday that it raised the long term counterparty ratings of brokerage firm SBC Warburg Australia Holdings Ltd and its SBC Warburg Australia Ltd unit to "AA plus" from "AA".
S&P said the ratings had been removed from Creditwatch with positive implications, where they were placed on February 12 this year.
It said the ratings outlook was stable.
The ratings upgrade followed the completion on July 1 of Swiss Bank Corp's move to full ownership of the SBC Warburg Australia group.
Swiss Bank has an AA plus long term rating, with a stable outlook.
